statement: This is a local capture of the production producer, executed against the installed Modal SDK 1.5.5 outside a Modal container and against a hostile environment: MODAL_WORKER_ID, HOSTNAME and MODAL_TASK_ID held arbitrary, well-formed but fake values for the duration of the call. No Modal invocation was made, the provider was never asked, no worker was deployed or touched, and the capture holds no provider-issued identifier: outside a Modal container the function-call id is NOT_AVAILABLE and the client-side container id is NOT_AVAILABLE as well, which is exactly what the truth is at that moment. That the fake environment values do not become an observed container id is the point of this capture. The OBSERVED branches of the producer are exercised by the test suite in a simulated container context and against a fake provider.
